text:
Researchers tested what happens when Google's AI Mode is forced on people, and the web got fewer visitors without searchers being happier.

In a 1,100-person experiment, forced AI Mode cut clicks to outside sites by 18.8 percentage points. People also reported lower trust and satisfaction.

Caveats: it is an arXiv preprint from Penn and Northeastern researchers, the test ran in March, and we found no Google response. One study, not a verdict. If you run a site, watch your own search traffic.

Source: arXiv:2608.18352, Aug 18
